ci.limit: No final-candidate CI outcome is inferred from earlier passing runs.

source_hash_binding: The final observed local build/test completed with exit 0. Every Sources/Tests/scripts entry in harness/logs/test-source-manifest.json was checked against the frozen files and matched. observations.limited_behavior: Exact supported UTF-8/UTF-16 BOM and Latin1/Windows1252 byte roundtrips; invalid and unrepresentable values rejected.
limits: 642 assertions cover codec and recovery fixtures together, not 642 product features.
All legacy encodings and native opening/interpretation UI remain incomplete.

observations.limited_behavior: Isolated persistence handles stale/corrupt/version/symlink/write-failure cases, private modes and excessive revision rejection; named and untitled snapshots survive an actual SIGKILL child process.
observations.evidence_type: helper and isolated process integration tests
limits: The SIGKILL fixture and separate CUA recovery do not exhaust power-loss, partial-write, original-file conflict or dirty-quit recovery behavior.

observations.limited_behavior: Native Scintilla preserves Unicode/NUL, shared bytes/dirty state and undo across destruction of original view.
limits: No claim of complete IME/dead-key/VoiceOver support or dirty last-window/quit dialogs.

observations.limited_behavior: Native commands move/join/trim selected lines, navigate braces/bookmarks, toggle visible whitespace/EOL/line numbers/overtype, fold lexer-derived lines and preserve text across palettes.
limits: 45 PASS assertions in current bridge log cover this and other bridge behaviors; full command variants/selection interactions remain open.
Enumerating lexer factories does not verify all language keyword/style data or UDL.

observations.limited_behavior: Native document saves/conflicts/failures/metadata, double-BOM content, clone geometry/shared edits/undo, revert, private automation persistence and clean-quit return policy.
limits: 49 assertions passed after repairs in the inspected log.
Shell native tests reported no physical NSScreen; native state/bitmap assertions are distinct from CUA onscreen observations.
Clean-quit return policy is tested; physical process termination and full dirty Quit/Cancel UI remain unverified.

observations.limited_behavior: Stable ID rename/bindings, quantities/fractions/duplicates, literal replacement and schema/step validation.
limits: 17 pure-core assertions; UI and destination integration not proved by helper tests.

observations.limited_behavior: Integrator observed native window/Unicode paste, shared editing/Undo, dirty-close Cancel, Save, configured automation shortcut/preview cancel/new-document apply preserving quantities, actual forced restart recovery of two snapshots, and both cloned panes visibly rendering.
limits: Selected native UI flows only; all trigger/scope/output combinations remain unverified.

These CUA observations predate the final standard responder-selector changes: Save-panel filename Command-A, modal editing shortcuts, immediate replacement-field execution, and clean/dirty Quit physical termination need final physical UI rechecks.

observations.limited_behavior: Injected fake stores test denied/revoked access, destination handling, partial/uncertain results, same-batch retries and private journal permissions.
limits: 33 assertions use injected stores only. No real EventKit permission, personal list read or export occurred.
Live end-to-end requires explicit consent and a designated writable test list.

observations.limited_behavior: Native typing/cursor/delete actions produce typed SCN_MACRORECORD steps; replay into clone shares grouped undo; arbitrary pointer messages rejected.
limits: Native typed subset only; unsupported recordable actions abort rather than silently omit.
No full regex, until-end or complete command recordability claim.

observations.limited_behavior: Native MacroController literal find/replace repeat and grouped Undo; missing-search partial-edit handling; invalidation rejects recording after clone focus, unsupported transform, automation, reload or native Undo; valid capture/view-only zoom remains saveable.

Native recording/menu walkthrough through CUA remains unverified. Unsupported scenarios reject a partial recording; they are not implemented full macro capabilities.
Repeat playback is bounded but synchronous; interactive cancellation/run-until-end and full regex recordability remain open.

observations.limited_behavior: Conventional ICNS encodes all ten 1x/2x sizes up to 1024 pixels; decoded artwork visually inspected against selected source.
limits: Conventional square fallback; actual Dock/older-system appearance and newer Icon Composer variants unverified.

required_open_gaps: Complete semantic normalization/deduplication of command, dynamic menu, dialog, preference and shortcut behavior; exact released standard package URL/version/hash and bundled-tool versions.
All standard encodings and explicit reopen/interpretation choices, mixed-EOL conversion controls, full metadata/xattr safety, comprehensive external-change coordination.
Forced-crash named/untitled recovery, partial-write fault integration, dirty cloned last-view and quit Save/Discard/Cancel, complete session/window/tab close variants.
Boost-compatible regex/extended search and replacement captures/escapes/zero-width/Unicode, selection/open-document/folder/project scopes, find-all/count/mark results and cancellation.
Full advanced selection/column edit, all sorting/case/whitespace/comment variants and preference-dependent behavior.
Notepad++ UDL LexUser deltas, complete language styles/keywords/associations, completion/call tips, function-list parsers and theme settings.
Document map/list, folder/project workspaces, monitoring append/truncate/conflicts, printing/page setup and utility panels.
Full macro recordability, regex find/replace macros, run-until-end, cancellation/progress and native saved-macro menu validation.
Preferences, arbitrary shortcut remapping/collisions, context-menu customization, localization and per-language defaults.
Configured Run commands, native extension contract/sample, and required bundled mimeTools/NppConverter/NppExport Mac equivalents.
Automation ask-at-run parameters, broader typed actions, asynchronous progress/cancellation, multi-selection output, per-workflow toolbar pins and all trigger/output acceptance combinations.
Live Reminders integration requires explicit consent and a dedicated writable scratch list; fake checks do not close native export.
IME/dead keys, VoiceOver keyboard/accessibility, deterministic large-file/long-line/many-tab performance budgets, macOS14 runtime and Intel runtime.
Clean-checkout final-candidate build, exact-SHA CI observation, candidate packaging hashes and final independent integrated review closure.
matrix_policy: This separate limited-evidence ledger does not change broad capability rows to pass. Assertion counts are not capability counts or a parity percentage.

delivery_records.policy: Candidate-specific identities are recorded outside tracked source to avoid self-referential commit hashes. These files are generated/updated by the integrator during final delivery.

review_scope.disposition: Substantiated scoped findings repaired and relevant regressions passed. No full-parity certification.
review_scope.independence_limit: Reviewers challenged components authored by other workers, then repaired findings. Self-authored components and their repairs are identified as self-review; not an independent second audit.

remaining_ui_rechecks: Physical clean and dirty Quit termination after final selector/lifecycle repairs, including Save/Discard/Cancel paths.
Native Save-panel filename selection and editing shortcuts after replacing custom selectors with standard responder selectors.
Modal automation/macro text-editor editing shortcuts and immediate replacement-field execution after final routing changes.
Native saved macro record/stop/save/play UI walkthrough and unsupported-action rejection presentation.
IME/dead-key composition and actual VoiceOver reading/navigation/editing.

tested_source_manifest.note: Manifest identifies the source tree used by the observed final local test run. Its historical base-commit/dirty fields are not the delivered candidate identity; use the delivery manifest and validation sidecar.

final_ui_recheck.observation: Final native UI recheck returned cgWindowNotFound while Finder was targeted. No latest app process-exit verification was obtained.
final_ui_recheck.effect: Earlier observed CUA flows remain bounded evidence; this failed recheck does not certify final Quit, filename selection or modal routing behavior.
